notes.title: The Lost Soul - Pre-Release Build #3314
notes.content:
[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new soundtracks
[*] Added new sounds
[*] Added new UI elements
[*] Changed the soundtrack playback system, now the soundtracks are played in random order, without repeating
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*] The amount of lives on the different difficulties increased from 100/70/30 to 250/100/40
[*] Partially changed level 11 structure
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed incorrect display of the walkthrough time in the results table
[*] Fixed incorrect display of player name
[*] Fixed game colliders at levels 3 and 7
[*] Fixed getting Steam achievements
[/list]
